_doc: Per-page metadata for the Category-32 (Condiments, Sauces and Dressings) standard renderer (tools/build-category-standard-pages.mjs). Numbers come from data/standards/cat32-compiled/<record>.json (deterministic; no authored values). Display + wiring + the category _meta block only.

_meta.methodology_version: Method v2.0 — government-limit default (CLAUDE.md Part 19, Governing Principles v2.0)

pages.name: Fish sauce (fermented anchovy/marine sauce)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for Fish sauce (fermented anchovy/marine sauce) (Condiments, Sauces and Dressings), stated as consumed. Each analyte carries the strictest applicable government maximum level in the product's native basis, with a disclosed read-across or a mandatory control where no government regulates the exact product.
